key.name: step-hours
key.description: Hours added or removed by one click on the + and − buttons.

key.name: max-hours
key.description: Upper bound of a single day: the + button stops there and a typed value is capped to it.

key.name: show-weekends
key.description: Display Saturdays and Sundays in the popup. When off, they are hidden and the daily reminder stays silent on those days.

key.name: reminder-enabled
key.description: Send a notification every day at the reminder time.

key.name: reminder-time
key.description: Time of the daily reminder, as HH:MM in local time.

key.name: export-dir
key.description: Folder the CSV export is written to. Empty means the user Documents directory.

key.name: data-path
key.description: Path of the JSON data file. Empty means the XDG default, ~/.local/share/daily-time-tracker/data.json.
